title: Making Everyone the Director of Their Own Life
summary: PixVerse reports that creator @nerdsoul gained 300,000 followers and 210 million views in two months, alongside a separate AI-film festival example.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: PixVerse describes @nerdsoul’s AI-generated character videos and their reported audience growth. It also describes an unnamed Portuguese creator’s 30-minute film selected for Fantasporto. These examples illustrate reported creative output and reach. The source does not establish earnings, preserved livelihoods, or population-level reductions in inequality.
purpose: Make video creation accessible with generative AI.

ratings.reason: Creator @nerdsoul reportedly used PixVerse to gain 300,000 followers and 210 million views in two months, a measurable creative-reach result.
Brand and educator applications are described in general, without a specified operational or revenue improvement.
The 1.4 million hashtagged videos measure activity, not reduced inequality or a population benefit.

ai_role.statement: The contributor describes the system and its proposed or reported contribution. This collection entry does not independently isolate the effect of AI from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 4: Making Everyone the Director of Their Own Life

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: PixVerse expands a creator’s reach and supports AI filmmaking

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
